notes.title: Playtest Update: Mission editor and new map!
notes.content:
[p]Pilots! A brand-new version of the Battle of BackYard Playtest has just been deployed—and it’s a big one. This update brings fresh air and allows for Your creativity![/p][p]  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747577/e891c09aea55d03128b3b3c48a3b9dfbd918ed58.png"][/img] [/p][h2]New map: Dadventure Bay Lake[/h2][p]A wide-open stretch of water with plenty of sky to burn and just enough terrain for cover.[/p][p]Perfect for long-range bombing runs, torpedo ambushes, or full-speed aerial jousting over the dock chairs.

[/p][h2]Mission editor: now fully functional[/h2][p]You've asked, we delivered: the mission editor is now in your hands![/p][p]Build your own missions, scatter buildings, place objectives, and challenge your friends in custom-built chaos.[/p][list][*][p]Set up fuel-starved scenarios[/p][/*][*][p]Fortify the skies with AA bunkers[/p][/*][*][p]Design impossible challenges for your squad (or your enemies)[/p][/*][*][p]And then play them live with friends
[/p][/*][/list][h2]Bugs? Probably.[/h2][p]This is still the early testing phase, so some things might explode unintentionally (or too intentionally). That’s where you come in.[/p][p][b]Join our Discord[/b], report bugs, share your mission setups, and help us shape the game into the glorious backyard battlefield it’s meant to be.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747577/e345b312756ddbc1150fcbc55dc42fa9ea2118db.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Playtest: This is not a drill!
notes.content:
The skies are now open to all aviators for the ongoing Battle of BackYard Playtest. No codes. No clearance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747577/086615e5cb94f2a6d156dd29ae61880f7e0457ae.png[/img]

We’re listening! Join our Discord, drop us a message, or yell at the nearest pigeon.
(But seriously, tell us what you think—we’re building this game with you in mind.)

[h2]Mission Briefing:[/h2]
Take to the skies
Engage in wild, chaotic dogfights across Basement Sea and living rooms
Test new aircraft classes, including the special plane of the US
Destroy bunkers, dodge flak, and outmaneuver enemy fighters
Deploy... unconventional weaponry (yes, that includes exploding rubber ducks)

[h2]This Is a Live Combat Simulation:[/h2]
Command needs YOUR feedback to fine-tune engines, balance payloads, and keep those AA guns fair (but still scary).
Every sortie counts. Every crash teaches. Every victory helps us win the war effort.
Join our Discord - link is in the game!

[h2]Enlist Now – No Questions Asked![/h2]
Click "Request Access" on Steam and join the fight immediately.
Glory, chaos, and questionable engineering await you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747577/fdfb8458f9bed93c4c99bc50683b46352beadd20.png[/img]

notes.title: [Production Report no.19]
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747577/45a5427bbe2b50b89a8fd1e0db810102e015f3b0.png[/img]

[b]Pilots, get ready to hit hard and break defenses![/b]

We’ve just finished adding a brand-new aircraft class to Battle of BackYard: Attack Aircraft!

While they may not be the best in a dogfight, these heavily armed beasts excel at taking down ground and naval targets, making them a crucial tool for breaking through enemy defenses. They’re tougher than fighters, faster than bombers, and built for destruction.

[h3]The Role of Attack Aircraft – Taking the Fight to the Ground[/h3]
In any battle, Anti-Aircraft (AA) guns are a menace. They can turn the sky into a death trap, limiting air superiority and making life miserable for both bombers and fighters. That’s where Attack Aircraft shine.
[list]
[*] Equipped with rockets, bombs, and powerful cannons, they can wipe out AA emplacements in a single run.
[*] More nimble than bombers, Attack Aircraft can maneuver well enough to evade some enemy fire, allowing skilled pilots to make multiple passes.
[/list]
[h3]The Aim of Assault Aircraft[/h3]
With the addition of Attack Aircraft, we’re deepening the strategic layer of the game. Players now have a dedicated class for destroying fortified positions, breaking enemy supply lines, and paving the way for larger assaults.

[b]Until next time, keep flying, keep fighting, and keep the skies clear![/b]

notes.title: [Production Report no.18]
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747577/966ad54576cd4f20ca0405ee4f82cf8fdf0ab5b3.png[/img]

[b]Commanders, prepare for battle![/b]

In Battle of BackYard, air combat is only part of the fight. With our in-game mission editor, players can shape the battlefield by placing strategic buildings like airfields, command centers, and fuel depots. But these aren’t just for decoration—they’re part of a larger tactical system that adds depth to every mission.

[img]https://battleofbackyard.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/Building.gif[/img]

[h3]How the Building System Works[/h3]
Players via mission editor can scatter various buildings across the battlefield to create unique scenarios, but the real magic happens when structures are connected, unlocking new strategic options. Here’re some examples:

[list]
[*] Fuel Depots & Airfields – Airfields linked to fuel depots allow planes to refuel mid-battle. In missions with scarce fuel pickups, protecting your depots (and raiding the enemy’s) becomes critical for survival.
[*] Bunkers & Anti-Aircraft Dioramas – AA guns positioned on dioramas will respawn if linked to a bunker. That means taking out enemy bunkers is the only way to permanently remove their anti-air defenses.
[*] Command Centers & Radar Stations – While not in place yet, we’re experimenting with features like command centers providing recon advantages or radar stations highlighting enemy movements.
[/list]

[img]https://battleofbackyard.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/Landing.gif[/img]

[h3]Building a Better Battle[/h3]
The mission editor lets players set up their own tactical challenges—whether it’s a chaotic free-for-all or a carefully balanced war of attrition. By controlling resource flow and defensive positions, every mission can feel unique, strategic, and dynamic.

This system is still evolving, and we’re testing different ways to push it even further. Got ideas for how to expand it? Drop your thoughts—we’re listening!

[b]Until next time, build smart, strike hard, and dominate the BackYard![/b]

notes.title: [Production Report no.17]
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747577/b60d30ffa79aa16bc8d98c1160f1ec3ee826a42c.png[/img]

[b]Hello, Pilots and Tacticians![/b] (As this is more technical news)

One of the biggest challenges in Battle of BackYard has been the complex verticality and clutter of our battlefield. From soaring over rooftops to squeezing through half-open windows and navigating tight indoor spaces, the environment demands a truly 3D-capable pathfinding system. Today, we’re excited to share some major progress on this front!

[h3]Pathfinding in a Fully 3D World[/h3]
Creating a pathfinding system that handles the vertical complexity of Battle of BackYard was no small task.
[list]
[*] [b]Dynamic Updates:[/b] The pathfinding system adapts in real time to changes in the environment. When doors open, things break, or obstacles are introduced, bots need to adjust their paths and navigate the new layout seamlessly.
[*] [b]True 3D Navigation:[/b] Our bots don’t just need to move left and right—they climb ut also dive, and weave through the air like real pilots. This ensures they remain competitive and unpredictable, whether they’re flying around the house or sneaking through a narrow garage door.
[/list]
[h3]Optimization and Scale[/h3]
We’re thrilled to announce that the core system is complete, and now we’re focused on optimization. Our goal is to support up to 63 bots in a single match without compromising performance. Whether it’s a chaotic dogfight or a calculated tactical mission, bots will operate efficiently, giving players a thrilling experience every time.

[i]What You can see below are two sets of generated paths. Blue one in "raw" based upon traversable-untraversable grid.
That one is then corrected to achieve more streamlined version (green one) that is optimized for AI.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747577/ef3cf20c329be901a79cc83afd91055a24067659.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747577/03fda6ba45a636b5c964ed28fc25491decd59771.png[/img]

[b]Until next time, keep flying high and watch out for those windows![/b]

notes.title: [Production Report no.16]
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747577/9aedaad60b2fa78e6e5d8ef827352f9fb7d8ccaa.png[/img]

[b]Greetings, Pilots of the Rising Sun![/b]

Today, we’re spotlighting the iconic A6M Zero, the pride of Imperial Japan’s air forces and one of the most recognizable aircraft of WWII.

[h3]Speed and Precision[/h3]
The A6M Zero is a plane of contrasts—light on armor but unmatched in agility. It’s a deadly choice for pilots who value maneuverability over brute force, excelling in tight dogfights and daring hit-and-run tactics. The plane sacrifices armor and durability for exceptional handling, making it perfect for outmaneuvering opponents but requiring a skilled pilot to survive prolonged engagements.

[h3]Active Skill: "Booster"[/h3]
Like all fighters, the Zero comes equipped with the Booster ability, giving players a burst of incredible speed for a short time. Use it to close the gap, escape a sticky situation, or gain the upper hand in high-speed chases.


The A6M Zero played a pivotal role in WWII as the mainstay of Imperial Japan’s air fleet, known for dominating the skies in the early stages of the war.
Will you embrace its legacy and become the ace of Imperial Japan?

[b]Until next time, fly smart, strike fast, and own the skies![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747577/847441b98916830439ca6786f8de3ab64e6593f5.png[/img]

notes.title: [Production Report no.15]
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747577/3992e369c4c231ab26477c48e5cb8c95aad1f589.png[/img]

Today, we’re taking a closer look at a crucial part of aerial combat: the Anti-Aircraft Guns. 

This weapons aren’t just static defenses—they’re a strategic asset that can change the flow of battle. Whether you're securing a critical objective, defending your fleet, or forcing enemies into unfavorable flight paths, AA guns add a new layer of depth and excitement to the battlefield.
Players can man these guns themselves for precise shooting, or let AI handle the defense while they focus on aerial combat.

[h3]The Types[/h3]
There are two primary types of AA guns, each with unique characteristics:
[list]
[*] [b]Machinegun AA Guns:[/b] These are your rapid-firing, lead-spitting defenses. Perfect for sustained fire, they’re ideal for taking down agile fighters and dive bombers.
[*] [b]Explosive Flak Guns[/b]: These pack a punch with their area-of-effect damage. Explosive flak is perfect for targeting larger planes like bombers or creating chaos in tightly packed airspace.
[/list]

And two types of placement:
[list]
[*] [b]Ground-based[/b]: Positioned strategically on dioramas or directly on terrain, these guns provide essential cover for ground-based objectives.
[*] [b]Maritime-based[/b]: Mounted on ships and carriers, these bring the heat to aerial threats over water.
[/list]

[h3]Here’s where things get really exciting: AA guns can be dropped into battle by cargo planes![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747577/aaf1a867393ff16822bfac2a4c92a75bc86be43a.png[/img]

notes.title: [Production Report no.14]
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747577/80b90d1ff9bc574ad63d8a9cd9b342e10d6d7a16.png[/img]

Ladies and gentlemen, the iconic Mustang has joined the roster of Battle of BackYard! This legendary fighter plane isn’t just a star of WWII history—it’s also one of the poster planes for aerial fights in backyard!

[h2]The Mustang in Action[/h2]
The Mustang combines power, speed, and endurance, making it a formidable choice for any pilot who wants versatility in the skies. Here’s what makes it shine:

[h3]Active Skill: "Booster"[/h3]
Like all fighters, the Mustang features the Booster active skill. With a quick tap, players can unleash an incredible burst of speed, perfect for chasing down enemies, evading danger, or getting into the perfect firing position.

[h3]Fuel Capacity That Goes the Distance[/h3]
True to its legacy as a long-range escort fighter, the Mustang boasts the largest fuel tank of any fighter aircraft in the game. This means more time dominating the skies and fewer emergency landings to refuel!

The Mustang is ready to soar. Will you take the reins of this legendary bird and claim the skies?
[b]Until next time, keep your throttle open and your aim steady![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747577/2c29478dcc1564b6b5e054cdb35fe5c0cd187653.png[/img]

notes.title: [Production Report no.13]
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747577/81c000e00fd14a0a9f3a8e2a12a6341eaa27afc8.png[/img]

Today’s update dives into the mechanics that define our planes and make aerial combat in Battle of BackYard more strategic and dynamic than ever. Specifically, we’re talking about Passive Skills—unique traits that bring depth to each class of aircraft and highlight their ideal combat roles.

[h2]Aircraft Classes and Passive Skills[/h2]
Aircraft in Battle of BackYard are divided into distinct classes: Fighter, Attack Plane, Bomber, Dive Bomber, Torpedo Bomber, Cargo, and Special. Each class (except Special) features defined passive or active skills tailored to their role in the skies. In this report, we’re focusing on passive skills and how they impact gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747577/8550b9a8c45188ba982c0911f118396fee9a0ff5.png[/img]
[h3][b]Bombers[/b]: Precision and Power[/h3]
Bombers can carry a massive payload of "bomb"-type weapons and drop them nearly instantaneously. This makes them perfect for carpet bombing, allowing pilots to blanket large areas with devastating firepower in a single pass.

[h3][b]Dive Bombers[/b]: Risk-Rewards Amplifier[/h3]
Dive bombers receive a damage multiplier for both their bomb-type weapons and the speed of their dives. The faster and steeper the dive, the greater the damage. While this maneuver is risky, it can obliterate key targets with precision strikes that turn the tide of battle.

[h3][b]Torpedo Bombers[/b]: Optimal Drop Precision[/h3]
Effect: Torpedo bombers gain additional damage based on the height of their drop. Carefully managing altitude before releasing torpedoes ensures devastating strikes on water-based targets.

[h3][b]Special Planes[/b]: Unique Skills[/h3]
While not covered in today’s report, Special Class aircraft each come with their own distinctive skills—active, passive, or a mix of both—designed to shake up traditional combat strategies. Stay tuned for more details in future updates!

We’re eager to see how these passive skills enhance your experience and bring new depth to aerial warfare. As always, thank you for your feedback and support—it’s what keeps our skies alive with action and creativity!

[b]Until next time, may your bombs fly true and your dives be daring![/b]

notes.title: [Production Report no.11]
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747577/7740ba6d4546309079d55636d276894c3ecd836d.png[/img]

[b]Design Your own battlefield![/b]

We’re excited to bring you an update that’s all about creativity and community-driven fun! Our Mission Editor is in the works, and though it’s still in the early stages, we’re already testing its functionalities. Here’s a glimpse into what’s coming:

[list]
[*] [b]Design Freedom[/b]: Players will have the ability to create missions from scratch, using a variety of tools to place objectives, set enemy formations, and customize mission parameters. Whether it’s a daring solo raid or a chaotic all-out dogfight, the possibilities are endless.
[*] [b]Testing in Progress[/b]: We’re currently testing the core functionalities of the editor to ensure it’s intuitive, flexible, and robust. Our goal is to make it easy for anyone to jump in and start creating, while still offering depth for those who want to get really creative.
[*] [b]Share the Fun[/b]: A key feature of the Mission Editor will be the ability to share your custom missions with the community. Players will be able to upload their creations, browse missions made by others, and rate their favorites. This is your chance to become a mission mastermind and see how your ideas stack up against those of other players!
[/list]

Stay tuned for more updates, and watch into our SneakPeek on Youtube (it may be little outdated at the moment as work is progressing pretty fast):
[previewyoutube=PszxTzMKhcE;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: [Production Report no.10]
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747577/67f95e9394ed254c7afa5585fc2eba6e2ff82c8d.png[/img]

[b]Ever wanted to give your trusty fighter a snazzy new paintjob?[/b]

We're thrilled to unveil a major new feature: the [b]Customization Menu[/b]. This latest addition is designed to enhance the gameplay experience by offering more control over aircraft aesthetics and performance insights.

[list]
[*] The new menu allows players to select unique paintjobs for each aircraft type. From classic military camo to bold and bright color schemes, there are plenty of options to ensure each plane stands out in the backyard battlefield.
[*] Payers can now compare aircraft parameters such as speed, armor, weapon capacity, and fuel tanks. This feature provides a comprehensive view of each plane's strengths and weaknesses, aiding in strategic planning and decision-making.
[*] The Customization Menu includes detailed information about each plane's special perks. For example, dive bombers can now deal additional damage when performing a dive-bombing maneuver. This insight helps players leverage their planes’ unique abilities for tactical advantage.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747577/66c268b6d65957317ec835b69a45e82c67a88401.png[/img]

Stay tuned for more updates, and as always, keep those wings sharp!

notes.title: [Production Report no.9]
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747577/ee7d2b6205708d614fdba2ecf537383ea031dca6.png[/img]

[b]New Addition - DC-5 Plane[/b]

We’re excited to announce a thrilling new addition to your aerial arsenal – the DC-5 plane! This game-changer is set to introduce a whole new level of strategy and cooperation to your backyard battles.

The DC-5 isn't your typical combat aircraft. This dedicated cargo plane brings unique mechanics that will redefine how you approach battlefield strategy.

Key Features:
[list]
[*] Aerial Mines: The DC-5 can drop aerial mines to create hazardous zones for enemy planes. Strategically place these mines to control airspace and protect key areas.
[*] Crate Drops: Need some heavy artillery on the ground? The DC-5 can drop crates equipped with anti-aircraft guns. These crates provide Your forces with essential firepower to defend against incoming threats.
[*] No Offensive Capabilities: The DC-5 cannot shoot, making it vulnerable to enemy fire. This plane is designed for support and requires careful planning and protection from teammates.
[/list]

Fly safe and happy gaming!

notes.title: [Production Report no.7]
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747577/c54259c8e5ebde1a1de8421f0013060a029c723e.png[/img]

[b]Giant of the high seas![/b]

In the vast expanse of the backyard swimming pool, mere runways won't suffice. We need more. The answer? Aircraft carriers!

The epitome of a fully functional base: equipped with runways, radar, and the ability to swap planes. But beware, they're not invincible. These mighty vessels can be sunk, and there's no easy path to repair.

Every decision counts in the battle for supremacy!

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747577/c264ff8ed61c46c84a1aec055de1ecfc79fb516a.png[/img]

[b]Day is ended, Darkness shrouds[/b]

Night operations are dangerous! Fights in a room with the lights off too... and good fun is not necessarily safe. We have just finished turning the lights on and off in rooms!

Does this mean that there will be night missions in the game in which you have to bomb an enemy factory in the dark while flying between the explosions of anti-aircraft missiles illuminating the air? Definitely yes!

Will we add air defense with an explosive force so powerful that it glues planes together in flight? Maybe...

notes.title: Be ready, soldier, when the duty calls!
notes.content:
Keep’em flying, aviators![img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44653913/e1ad1fda9a2952ed44828642b7765070708b8e34.png[/img]
War rages on in the backyards and peaceful rooms of suburbia! Enlist now to defend freedom on the miniature battlefield of World War II. The call to duty echoes in the skies as both American and Japanese sides seek valiant pilots, fearless gunners, and vigilant AA-specialists. The sky's no limit* for those who dare to rewrite history!

*Ok, there IS technical limit You can fly. Be real. This is game about model planes fighting Pacific Area WW2 in someones back yard, not a space program!
